source.reductions: Retain the pinned cluster-apps to kubernetes/apps relationship and the exact Hermes app path, relative kopiur/backup Component edge, targetNamespace ai, sourceRef and substitution constants. The linked pinned Component remains a Component; snapshot/PVC resources become one authored ConfigMap. Omit unrelated external readiness and HelmRelease defaults. Add one explicitly authored hermes-peer consumer in ai-peer and a backup-policy edit to prove shared reach; neither is claimed as copied upstream behavior. Independent baseline/current trees preserve both sides.
